ui.title: Telegram messages
ui.lede: Get a message in Telegram when you are outbid, when you win a card and when a payment is due. This is optional. Hammerprice stores only your Telegram chat id and the choices below.
ui.choose: What do you want to receive?

outbid.label: Outbid
outbid.hint: Someone bid more than you on a lot.

ending_soon.label: Lot ending soon
ending_soon.hint: A lot you bid on is about to close. Best effort: it is sent when a bid or the daily check processes the lot, so it can come late or not at all.

won.label: You won, payment due
won.hint: You won a lot. The message has the link to pay.

settled.label: Settlement done
settled.hint: The card moved and the payment went through, with the receipt on the explorer.

show_start.label: Show starts
show_start.hint: A show you registered a bidder number for has started.

deadline.label: Payment deadline
deadline.hint: A reminder when your payment deadline is close. The daily check sends it.

moderation.label: Chat moderation
moderation.hint: Only for room operators: chat messages that wait for approval, with buttons to approve, reject or mute.

pack_delivery.label: Pack delivery due
pack_delivery.hint: Only for pack operators: a pack of yours was paid and drawn, and you must deliver the card in time. A reminder follows when the deadline is close.

lot_watch.label: Lot alerts (watch a room)
lot_watch.hint: One short message for each of the next lots of a room you chose with /watch in the chat, when the lot opens, with buttons that open the room with a bid filled in. Nothing is bid for you: you confirm and sign every bid yourself in your own wallet. Switching this off ends all your watches.

ui.signInFirst: Sign in with your wallet first. Afterwards this page takes you straight to the Telegram step.
ui.waiting: Open Telegram and tap Start. The link works for 10 minutes and only once. This page updates when you are connected.
ui.expired: The link ran out. Press Connect Telegram again.
ui.stopHint: You can disconnect here or send /stop to the bot at any time.
ui.error: That did not work. Try again.
ui.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a moment and try again.
ui.privacy: Telegram is a separate service with its own privacy policy. Hammerprice keeps your chat id and these choices until you disconnect, and never your Telegram name or phone number.

bot.welcome:
Connected. Hammerprice will message you here about the bids and payments you chose. You do not need to press anything else; to change what you receive, tap this link and the Telegram settings open directly: {account}

Commands: /status, /watch, /help, /stop
bot.linkInvalid: This link ran out or was already used. Tap this link, sign in with your wallet if asked, and press Connect Telegram for a new one: {account}
bot.alreadyLinked: You are connected. Send /status to see your open bids and payments, or /help for the commands.
bot.notLinked: Hammerprice sends bid and payment messages here. To connect, tap this link to open your account page (sign in with your wallet if asked), then press Connect Telegram: {account}
bot.stopped: Disconnected. Hammerprice will not message you here anymore. To connect again, tap this link and press Connect Telegram: {account}
bot.help:
Hammerprice bot

/status: your open bids, payments and watched rooms
/watch: alerts for the next lots of a live room (/watch 5 or /watch all)
/unwatch: stop the lot alerts
/stop: disconnect this chat
/help: this list

The bot never bids for you. Every bid is confirmed and signed by you, in your own wallet.
To change what you receive, tap this link: {account}
bot.unknown: I only understand /start, /status, /watch, /unwatch, /help and /stop. Send /help for the list.
bot.statusEmpty: You have no open bids and nothing to pay.
bot.statusBidLeading: {lot}: your bid of {amount} USDC is the highest.
bot.statusBidOutbid: {lot}: you were outbid, the highest bid is {amount} USDC.
bot.outbid:
You were outbid on {lot}. The highest bid is now {amount} USDC.
Bid again: {link}
bot.endingSoon:
{lot} closes in about {minutes} min. The highest bid is {amount} USDC.
Open the room: {link}
bot.won:
You won {lot} for {amount} USDC. Pay by {due} so the card moves to your wallet.
{link}
bot.settledBuyer:
Done. {lot} is in your wallet.
Receipt on the explorer: {receipt}
bot.settledSeller:
Done. {lot} was paid and delivered ({amount} USDC).
Receipt on the explorer: {receipt}
bot.deadline:
Reminder: pay for {lot} ({amount} USDC) by {due}. After that the sale expires and counts as a strike.
{link}
bot.packSold:
A pack of yours was paid: {pack}. The buyer paid you {amount} USDC directly and the card is drawn. Sign the delivery by {due}.
{link}
bot.packDue:
Reminder: the card for the pack sale {pack} is still not delivered. Deliver it by {due}, otherwise the sale counts as undelivered, costs you a strike and pauses your pack.
{link}
bot.cbMuted: Bidder muted for {minutes} min, message rejected.
bot.resultMuted: Bidder {paddle} muted for {minutes} min, message rejected: {body}
bot.cbNotAllowed: You are not the operator of this room.
bot.cbInvalid: This button is no longer valid.
bot.cbNotLinked: Connect this chat on your account page first.
bot.watchOn: Done. You get a message when each of the next {n} lots of {show} opens. /unwatch stops it, and it stops by itself when the show ends. Lot alerts are switched on for this chat. Nothing is ever bid for you.
bot.watchOnAll: Done. You get a message when each lot of {show} opens, until the show ends. /unwatch stops it. Lot alerts are switched on for this chat. Nothing is ever bid for you.
bot.watchNone: There is no live room and no scheduled room to watch right now. Send /watch again when a show starts.
bot.watchGone: This room is over or not available. Send /watch to pick another.
bot.watchBad: Send /watch for a choice, or /watch 5 or /watch all.
bot.unwatched: Stopped. You get no more lot alerts.
bot.unwatchNone: You were not watching a room.
bot.watchEnded: {show} has ended. The lot alerts for it stopped.
bot.watchLeftAll: every lot until the show ends
bot.lotNote: Nothing is bid for you. The buttons only open the room with the amount filled in; you confirm and sign in your own wallet.
bot.lotLeft: {n} more alerts for this room. /unwatch stops them.
